last.q: Today’s companies run on a combined workforce of people and AI agents,
last.a: said Gerrit Kazmaier, president, product and technology, Workday

last.q: We had a strong Q2, with AI driving more than 25% of our new ACV and more than 5,500 customers now using at least one of our organic agents,
last.a: said Aneel Bhusri, co-founder, CEO, and chair, Workday

last.q: We had a great Q1, and it makes one thing clear: Workday is ready for this AI moment. Our core business is strong, our AI strategy is working, and we’re moving with the speed and focus required to lead,
last.a: said Aneel Bhusri, co-founder, CEO, and chair, Workday

last.q: We built Workday to bring innovation back to the worlds of HR and finance, and AI gives us the chance to do it all again,
last.a: said Aneel Bhusri, co-founder, CEO and chair, Workday

last.q: Aneel and Dave Duffield founded Workday with a belief that work could be done differently, and they built one of the most innovative companies in enterprise software,
last.a: said Mark Hawkins, Workday vice chair and lead independent director

last.q: Workday delivered another solid quarter, fueled by the strength and diversity of our business and the momentum we’re seeing across our AI portfolio,
